description: This is a front-end HTML file that provides a user interface for visualizing and interacting with database data, including UI styling, layout, and client-side JavaScript logic for fetching and displaying database information.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar with clickable database items.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list and resets the UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a given database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches the data for a selected table and renders it in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML table from the data received and adds it to the DOM.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full text or object data.
